criterion: The floor for each case is the shortest response the case's own frozen trap has passed. A judge false-pass would set that floor for free, so every one is read in full against the trap text in evals/cases/<case>/expect.json and labelled here. `sound` means the response satisfies the trap as written. `sound-code` means it satisfies the trap and the prose word count understates it, because metrics.score excludes fenced blocks and inline code and this answer is carried by identifiers or a command - the floor is a prose floor, not a length. `unsound` means the verdict is a judge error and the floor must be taken from the next shortest passing response instead. One pass, by the author of ../judged-floor-136.md, every response read in full.
